$comment: NON-EXECUTABLE source inventory of RF Clinical Rule Specification v1.2 governed rule entries. This is a planning index ONLY: it lists the rules that will later be converted into Gate B machine-readable rule objects. It is NOT a set of authored rule objects, executes nothing, and confers no approval. Extracted from docs/governance/Master_Rectus_Femoris_Clinical_Rule_Specification_v1.2.md (rule bodies §§7-14 and Appendix A). No evidence-claim IDs or architecture references were invented; where the spec is not explicit, null / [] / "needs_manual_review" is used.

source_rules.rule_title: Disproportionate or passive-movement pain after significant trauma
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; MUST. No ACS confirm/exclude.

source_rules.rule_title: Progressive swelling or tightness after major trauma
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; MUST. No home thigh-girth threshold.

source_rules.rule_title: Delayed deterioration
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; MUST. Reopens safety despite prior CLEAR.

source_rules.rule_title: Suspected vascular or neurological compromise
source_rules.notes: Architecture source; platform-wide trauma safety, not an RF-specific clinical claim.

source_rules.rule_title: Inability to safely assess
source_rules.notes: Architecture source; record cannot_assess, never coerce to positive/negative.

source_rules.rule_title: Suspected avulsion, full-thickness, or postoperative restriction
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; sets REHAB_BLOCKED while restrictions unresolved.

source_rules.rule_title: Direct-contusion branch routing
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; OUT_OF_SCOPE if no approved contusion module exists.

source_rules.rule_title: New red flags during rehabilitation
source_rules.notes: Architecture source; new safety overrides phase/progression/trends.

source_rules.rule_title: Mechanism activates questions, not diagnostic weighting
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; dual permitted_use in body (logic for activation; evidence_record_only for mechanism %). QRF-039 reference-only.

source_rules.rule_title: Sudden stabbing pain (non-specific history)
source_rules.notes: Clinical_content; MAY. No architecture refs in body.

source_rules.rule_title: Audible pop or snap (concern signal, not diagnostic)
source_rules.notes: Clinical_content; MAY.

source_rules.rule_title: Direct versus indirect mechanism branching
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; QRF-001 and QRF-039 retained as non-weighting mechanism context.

source_rules.rule_title: Self-tests are supporting evidence only
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; ASLR/femoral-slump not validated RF rule-out tests.

source_rules.rule_title: Imaging and report descriptor handling
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; QRF-006 only when bull's-eye descriptor is specifically relevant; raw images need validated subsystem.

source_rules.rule_title: Strong diagnosis anchor reduces identity questions only
source_rules.notes: Architecture source; never bypasses safety/capacity/stage/readiness.

source_rules.rule_title: Strong-anchor conflict triggers external reassessment
source_rules.notes: Architecture source; silent replacement prohibited.

source_rules.rule_title: Munich classification for guarded group context
source_rules.notes: Clinical_content; MAY. Medians are not individual timelines.

source_rules.rule_title: Separate BAMIC ontology from MRI-confirmed RF outcome context
source_rules.notes: Clinical_content; MAY. Dual permitted_use in body (evidence_record_only for ontology; logic for bounded outcome). QRF-009 ontology-only.

source_rules.rule_title: Documented central-aponeurosis location widens uncertainty
source_rules.notes: Clinical_content; MAY. No deterministic return-date formula.

source_rules.rule_title: Proximal or full-thickness injury benchmarks
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; dual permitted_use in body (evidence_record_only for benchmarks; prohibited_autonomous_rule for treatment/timing).

source_rules.rule_title: Reported fibrosis/scar is provenance-tagged history, not severity
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; QRF-045 applies only to the separate chronic structural pathway.

source_rules.rule_title: Phase entry requires a complete prescription input
source_rules.notes: Architecture source; diagnosis alone never authorizes a full plan.

source_rules.rule_title: Loading dimensions are ontology metadata, not a universal sequence
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; MAY. Dual permitted_use in body (logic for selection; evidence_record_only for any proposed sequence).

source_rules.rule_title: RF-biased position tag
source_rules.notes: Clinical_content; MAY. ~40deg hip flexion tag; cannot set dosage/eligibility.

source_rules.rule_title: No universal RF dosage
source_rules.notes: Clinical_content; PROHIBITION. Any active universal RF dose must fail content validation.

source_rules.rule_title: Schedule and total-load reconciliation
source_rules.notes: Architecture source; modify/restrict/block if schedule cannot satisfy constraints.

source_rules.rule_title: Concurrent injury constraints govern or block the plan
source_rules.notes: Architecture source; terminal REHAB_BLOCKED if no compatible plan exists.

source_rules.rule_title: Prior injury changes recurrence handling without a universal delay
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; QRF-041 conditional on valid MRI class; QRF-043 reference-only; QRF-033/QRF-034 are I1 population limits.

source_rules.rule_title: Recurrence-sensitive exposure domains remain separate and unranked
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; QRF-039 and QRF-043 reference-only. No 'highest-risk' ranking; no fibrosis-based slowing.

source_rules.rule_title: Aspetar MSS milestones with denominator and population limits
source_rules.notes: Clinical_content; MAY. 70/80/95% MSS as expert criteria only; no universal mandatory thresholds.

source_rules.rule_title: 95% maximum sprint speed is not sufficient alone
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; MUST.

source_rules.rule_title: Higher-speed exposure requires verified prerequisite capacity
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; MUST. No hidden speed threshold.

source_rules.rule_title: Kicking exposure is a separately monitored sport-demand domain
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; MUST. Epidemiological percentages are reference-only; kicking not universally ranked above other demands.

source_rules.rule_title: Sprint work-to-rest ratios are not RF-specific dosage rules
source_rules.notes: Clinical_content; PROHIBITION. 1:3/1:5/1:7 must not become RF autonomous dosing.

source_rules.rule_title: No date-only individual clearance
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; PROHIBITION. Dual permitted_use in body (prohibited for date-only; evidence_record_only for cohort benchmarks).

source_rules.rule_title: Unrestricted training follows multi-domain Simulation evidence
source_rules.notes: Mixed source; SHOULD. Expert-pathway structure, not proof of safety.

source_rules.rule_title: Readiness-tier honesty and output locks
source_rules.notes: Architecture source; home-only assessment not equal to supervised testing.

source_rules.rule_title: Outstanding performance deficits remain active targets
source_rules.notes: Architecture source; Resilience continues while capacity-to-demand gap remains open.

extraction_warnings: Architecture-section ranges in the spec (e.g. '§§13.1-13.2', '§§12-14') were expanded into discrete architecture_refs tokens; granularity should be confirmed against V3.1 during Gate B authoring.

Several rules carry a dual/contextual permitted_use in their body (RF-DX-001, RF-DX-004, RF-SEV-002, RF-SEV-004, RF-REHAB-002, RF-RTS-001). This inventory records the Appendix A primary permitted_use only; the secondary role is captured in notes and needs manual review before authoring.

Evidence-claim roles differ per claim (decision-driving vs reference-only / evidence_record_only) per Appendix B. This inventory lists claim IDs without their per-claim role; roles must be reattached during Gate B authoring and must preserve each claim's individual grade.

Clinical_content-only rules (RF-DX-002, RF-DX-003, RF-SEV-001, RF-SEV-002, RF-SEV-003, RF-REHAB-003, RF-REHAB-004, RF-FIELD-001, RF-FIELD-005) legitimately have empty architecture_refs per v1.2 §4.3; [] here means 'none in source', not 'missing'.
Architecture-source rules legitimately have empty evidence_claim_ids per v1.2 §4.3; [] here means 'none required', not 'missing'.

rule_family values are normalized lowercase tokens derived from Appendix A domains (e.g. 'Running/sprinting' -> 'running_sprinting', 'History/structure' -> 'history_structure'); confirm the canonical family vocabulary before authoring.
Rule titles are concise summaries, not the spec's normative prose; the authoritative wording remains in v1.2.
